# Covers and editorial visuals

Agree on the recipient's own brand before creating branded assets. Ask for screenshots, examples or a template, and whether the owner wants to supply images or have them created. The original company's logos, proprietary fonts and cover assets are intentionally not included.

Use available image tools, optionally fal.ai when connected, only for authorized asset work. First write a short visual brief: purpose, takeaway, placement, labels, dimensions, accessibility and brand references. Preserve approved work. Keep editable sources and attribution beside exported images. Check the final image and the actual page at desktop and mobile sizes. Do not replace missing designer content with an invented reconstruction.
